input: What happens to him now? I don't want him punished for more than he actually did.
draft:
Doran Hale stood just inside the doorway, his weight settling as he took in the room — the spilled drink pooling on the counter, Dell on his feet and swaying slightly, Nicco backed off with open hands and the counter between them. He let Jessa finish, let Nicco finish, let Dell finish. Then he looked at Dell.

"Bumped his stool," Hale said, not raising his voice. "Is that what you're telling me." He crossed to the counter, glanced at the spilled drink, then at Dell's coat. "You've been drinking."

Dell's mouth opened, but Hale held up a hand. "I heard what happened. You grabbed him, you shoved him. He didn't hit you back." He turned to Nicco. "You're saying you don't want charges. You want him gone for the night." It landed as a question without the inflection of one. He looked at Jessa. "This match what you saw?"

Jessa met his gaze. "Dell knocked the man's drink over and put hands on him. This one kept his hands open and stepped back. That's what I saw." She wiped the counter with a cloth, matter-of-fact, already past it.

Hale nodded. He turned back to Dell. "You're done here tonight. Gather your things and walk out. Come back when you can sit in a room without putting hands on someone." His tone carried no particular anger — just the flat certainty of a man who had said this before and expected to say it again.
